article.headline: Braeden Carrington, Owen Foxwell guide Wisconsin to 73-64 victory over Delaware
article.description: — Braeden Carrington and Owen Foxwell scored 16 points apiece and Wisconsin beat Delaware 73-64 on Friday night.
article.linkText: Braeden Carrington, Owen Foxwell guide Wisconsin to 73-64 victory over Delaware
article.story: MADISON, Wis. -- — Braeden Carrington and Owen Foxwell scored 16 points apiece and Wisconsin beat Delaware 73-64 on Friday night. Carrington made half of his 12 shots with four 3-pointers for the Badgers (2-0). Foxwell hit 4 of 9 shots with a 3-pointer and 7 of 9 free throws, adding six assists. Victory Onuetu, Nolan Winter and Eian Elmer all finished with 11 points for Wisconsin. Onuetu added 11 rebounds for the double-double and blocked two shots. Chuck Bailey III hit five 3-pointers on his way to a career-high 26 points for the Blue Hens (1-1). Kachi Nzeh scored 11. Jameel Brown hit a 3-pointer to pull Delaware even at 16-all midway through the first half. Carrington answered with a 3-pointer for Wisconsin and the Badgers led until Bailey's layup gave the Blue Hens a 26-25 lead with 3:40 left. Onuetu had a three-point play and Foxwell hit a jumper to help Wisconsin take a 35-28 lead into halftime. Bailey scored the final five points in a 7-0 run to start the second half and Delaware pulled even, but Carrington followed with a 3-pointer and the Badgers never trailed again over the final 18:10. Up next Delaware: Hosts James Madison on Wednesday. Wisconsin: Hosts Fairfield on Tuesday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
